package nats

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

type recordingJetStreamPublisher struct {
	messages []*natsgo.Msg
	err      error
}

func (publisher *recordingJetStreamPublisher) PublishMsg(message *natsgo.Msg, _ ...natsgo.PubOpt) (*natsgo.PubAck, error) {
	publisher.messages = append(publisher.messages, message)
	if publisher.err != nil {
		return nil, publisher.err
	}
	return &natsgo.PubAck{Stream: "LEARNING_PLANNER_EVENTS", Sequence: uint64(len(publisher.messages))}, nil
}

func TestPublisherPublishesExactS9OutcomeSubject(t *testing.T) {
	jetStream := &recordingJetStreamPublisher{}
	publisher := &Publisher{
		URL: "nats://publisher-test", Name: "test", ConnectTimeout: time.Second, jetStream: jetStream,
	}
	event := domain.IntegrationEvent{
		EventID:       "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		Subject:       domain.SubjectOnboardingPathOutcome,
		CorrelationID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CausationID:   "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		SchemaVersion: 1,
		Payload:       []byte(`{"schema":"planner-onboarding-path-outcome.v1"}`),
	}
	if err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), event); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("publish exact S9 subject: %v", err)
	}
	if len(jetStream.messages) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("published messages = %d, want 1", len(jetStream.messages))
	}
	message := jetStream.messages[0]
	if message.Subject != domain.SubjectOnboardingPathOutcome || message.Header.Get(natsgo.MsgIdHdr) != event.EventID ||
		message.Header.Get("X-Event-ID") != event.EventID || message.Header.Get("X-Correlation-ID") != event.CorrelationID ||
		message.Header.Get("X-Causation-ID") != event.CausationID || message.Header.Get("X-Schema-Version") != "1" ||
		string(message.Data) != string(event.Payload) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected S9 publication: subject=%q headers=%v", message.Subject, message.Header)
	}
}

func TestPublisherRejectsNeighboringS9SubjectsBeforeConnecting(t *testing.T) {
	for _, subject := range []string{
		"planner.onboarding-path.outcome",
		"planner.onboarding-path.outcome.v1.extra",
		"planner.onboarding-path.outcome.v2",
		"planner.onboarding-path.outcomes.v1",
		"planner.course.outcome.v1",
	} {
		t.Run(subject, func(t *testing.T) {
			jetStream := &recordingJetStreamPublisher{}
			publisher := &Publisher{URL: "nats://publisher-test", Name: "test", ConnectTimeout: time.Second, jetStream: jetStream}
			err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), domain.IntegrationEvent{
				EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", Subject: subject, Payload: []byte(`{}`),
			})
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected neighboring subject rejection")
			}
			if len(jetStream.messages) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("rejected subject reached JetStream: %#v", jetStream.messages)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPublisherRetainsOnlyExactLegacyCoursePlanSubjects(t *testing.T) {
	for _, subject := range []string{domain.SubjectCoursePlanCompleted, domain.SubjectCoursePlanFailed} {
		t.Run(subject, func(t *testing.T) {
			jetStream := &recordingJetStreamPublisher{}
			publisher := &Publisher{URL: "nats://publisher-test", Name: "test", ConnectTimeout: time.Second, jetStream: jetStream}
			if err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), domain.IntegrationEvent{
				EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", Subject: subject, Payload: []byte(`{}`),
			}); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("exact legacy course-plan subject rejected: %v", err)
			}
			if len(jetStream.messages) != 1 || jetStream.messages[0].Subject != subject {
				t.Fatalf("legacy publication = %#v", jetStream.messages)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPublisherRejectsUnknownCoursePlanSubjectWithoutPublishing(t *testing.T) {
	for _, subject := range []string{"course.plan.unknown", "course.plan.completed.extra"} {
		t.Run(subject, func(t *testing.T) {
			jetStream := &recordingJetStreamPublisher{}
			publisher := &Publisher{URL: "nats://publisher-test", Name: "test", ConnectTimeout: time.Second, jetStream: jetStream}
			err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), domain.IntegrationEvent{
				EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", Subject: subject, Payload: []byte(`{}`),
			})
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected unknown course-plan subject rejection")
			}
			if len(jetStream.messages) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("rejected subject reached JetStream: %#v", jetStream.messages)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPublisherRejectsSubjectOutsidePlannerNamespaceBeforeConnecting(t *testing.T) {
	publisher := &Publisher{URL: "nats://127.0.0.1:1", Name: "test", ConnectTimeout: time.Millisecond}
	err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), domain.IntegrationEvent{
		EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", Subject: "course.created", Payload: []byte(`{}`),
	})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected subject rejection")
	}
}

func TestPublisherRejectsInvalidEnvelopeBeforeConnecting(t *testing.T) {
	publisher := &Publisher{URL: "nats://127.0.0.1:1", Name: "test", ConnectTimeout: time.Millisecond}
	err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), domain.IntegrationEvent{
		EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", Subject: domain.SubjectCoursePlanCompleted,
		Payload: []byte(`not-json`),
	})
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected payload rejection")
	}
}
